Text: Level 0 (Nothing Available): No animals for rent; no food or stabling available.

Level 1 (Below Normal): Animals available — Mules [[1d4-1]], Ponies [[1d4-2]], Small Riding Horse [[1d4-1]], Draft Horse [[1d4-1]], Light War Horse [[1d6-5]], Heavy War Horse [[1d8-7]]; Special mount: roll [[1d100]] check (on 01, unicorn/pegasus present). Food & Care: Limited quantity, poor quality, no grooming/repair services; Daily Cost: 1 penny.

Level 2 (Normal): Animals available — Mules [[1d3]], Ponies [[1d4-1]], Small Riding Horse [[1d6-1]], Draft Horse [[1d4]], Light War Horse [[1d8-5]], Heavy War Horse [[1d6-4]]; Special mount: roll [[1d100]] check (on 01-05, unicorn/pegasus present). Food & Care: Sufficient quantity, average quality, animals combed; Daily Cost: 1 penny.

Level 3 (Above Normal): Animals available — Mules [[1d4]], Ponies [[1d6-2]], Small Riding Horse [[1d6]], Draft Horse [[1d4]], Light War Horse [[1d6-2]], Heavy War Horse [[1d6-3]]; Special mount: roll [[1d100]] check (on 01-15, unicorn/pegasus present). Food & Care: Plentiful quantity, good quality, animals combed, hooves cleaned, tack cleaned; Daily Cost: 3 pennies.

Level 4 (Special): Animals available — Mules [[1d6]], Ponies [[1d3]], Small Riding Horse [[1d8]], Draft Horse [[1d6-1]], Light War Horse [[1d6-1]], Heavy War Horse [[1d6-2]]; Special mount: roll [[1d100]] check (on 01-50, unicorn/pegasus present). Food & Care: Plentiful quantity, excellent quality, all services included (combed, hooves cleaned, minor healing, tack cleaned & repaired); Daily Cost: 6 pennies.
